findings: Investigation identified three concurrent contributing factors: (1) prod deploy v0.4.2 (and subsequent v0.4.3) is annotated as correlated with billing failures and requires human sign-off to roll back; (2) the SMTP relay at smtp.mailer.internal:587 is returning ConnectionRefused, blocking email sends and making the related DLQ messages non-replayable until the relay recovers — possibly linked to VPC egress changes in v0.4.2; (3) a non-retryable poison message in the DLQ stems from a malformed CSV upload (non-numeric value at row 15,382) that requires the uploader to be notified and a validation fix deployed. A secondary Stripe API timeout (bulk_api_sync, trace 6f76e48d) is retryable once Stripe is confirmed healthy.
recommendation: Start by reviewing the v0.4.2/v0.4.3 deploy notes and signing off on a rollback if billing impact is confirmed, then check the ECS task health for smtp.mailer.internal and any VPC egress rule changes introduced by v0.4.2 before replaying the SMTP-related DLQ messages; separately, notify the CSV uploader about the bad data at row 15,382 and gate future uploads with a pre-validation step.
